## Why

The bug, the measurement, or the request behind it. A number where there is one.

## Checklist

- [ ] The failing test came first, and `pytest -q` is green.
- [ ] If `docs/api.md` changed, `CHANGELOG.md` has the line, under *breaking* if it breaks.
- [ ] The public tree stays in English, with no real people, private recordings or machine paths in it.
- [ ] One change per PR.
